Default.welcomeText: ($1) - in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play this game!
Default.aboutToSeeText: ... is about to see the secret word and type a clue.
Default.writeCluePrompt: Write a 1-word clue related to the word "($1)"!
Default.whoNeedsTutorialQuestion: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.tut1Text: Duplicate is a collaborative game. Each round there's a secret word, and one player is the guesser. Everyone else gives clues to help them guess it!
Default.tut2Text: Everyone who isn't the guesser secretly writes a single word related to the secret word.
Default.tut3Text: All the clues are revealed, and any duplicate clues — ones that more than one person wrote — are removed. Think of something clever that no one else will!
Default.tut4Text: The remaining unique clues are shown to the guesser, who uses them to guess the secret word. The host confirms whether they got it right.
Default.tut5Text: If the guesser gets the word right, everyone earns 10 points. There's one round per player, so everyone gets a turn to guess!
